question:
A mirror is placed on the line AB. Out of the option figures which figure will be the right image of the question figure?

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: When a mirror is placed on the right side, the **image** and each letter is **laterally inverted (horizontally flipped)**.

The correct mirror image of the given figure is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bad9ff809219acbd28d0508e6d5bc44c3c44d89d473b5b2c7d36aeb3d5d3646.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
